takeaways.text: Lines up **Backfield** on **50%** of 130 plays (n=65); also Slot 20% (n=26).
Route on **88%** / blocks on **12%** of dropbacks (95% CI 82–93%, n=130) — 16 pts above the FB average of 72%.
On routes, averages **6.8 yd** downfield by the throw (n=115, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Backfield (50%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (6.4 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
